build_cuda_cpp_scheduling: build a CUDACPPScheduling instance to handle fusion decisions and CUDA C++ template code generation
test_is_cuda_cpp_template: test whether a scheduler node is a CUDA C++ template by checking if it wraps a CUDATemplateBuffer
check_can_fuse_epilogue: check if a pointwise computed buffer node can be fused with a CUDA C++ template epilogue
codegen_cuda_template: codegen a CUDA template kernel with optional fused epilogue nodes and emit compiled source code
define_cuda_kernel: define a CUDA kernel from source code, generating a unique kernel name and compile wrapper
